scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun build packages/sdk/src/game.ts --outfile apps/host/public/sdk/game.js --format esm --target browser
scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build --compile apps/host/src/index.ts --outfile dist/sofa-party
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/host/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
